title: DTF Terpene Atlas compound record — identity-safe v2

fields.class: monoterpene | sesquiterpene | diterpene | triterpene | other-terpene | terpenoid
fields.subclass: hydrocarbon, alcohol, oxide, ketone, ester, etc.
fields.aromaDescriptors: source-backed sensory vocabulary; never implied medical effects
fields.evidence: array of source ids supporting occurrence/classification
fields.evidenceGrade: A primary analytical / B review with traceable primary sources / C secondary reference
fields.notes: scientific limitations, stereochemistry, isomer or naming cautions
fields.isomerGroup: stable identifier linking positional/geometric/stereochemical isomers without collapsing them into one measured analyte
fields.stereochemistry: explicit isomer/stereochemical designation when the literature or analytical source resolves it
fields.parentConceptId: optional broader concept used for navigation when multiple resolved analytes share a familiar common name
fields.inchikey: PubChem/standard InChIKey when verified; preferred stable structure identity key
fields.iupacName: verified systematic name when useful for disambiguation
fields.canonicalSmiles: structure string including stereochemical information when the verified source resolves it
fields.analyteResolution: what the record actually resolves: parent concept, constitutional isomer, geometric isomer, enantiomer, or fully specified analyte

identityPolicy.rule: Do not merge analytical records solely by common name when positional, geometric, optical, or other stereochemical ambiguity exists.
identityPolicy.preferredAuthority: PubChem identifiers and structure properties are used as chemical-identity references when verified.
identityPolicy.unresolvedState: Missing identifiers remain explicitly unresolved; the Atlas must not infer stereochemistry from aroma, cultivar name, or a broad common name.
identityPolicy.measurementRule: A measured analyte may map to a broad parent concept for navigation, but quantitative results must preserve the resolution reported by the laboratory or source.
